title: Azure ML vs AI Services
description: Choose between Azure Machine Learning and Cognitive Services for ML workloads.

data.text: You need to build a custom image classification model for defect detection in manufacturing. Should you use Azure Machine Learning, Cognitive Services Custom Vision, or a combination?

Use **Azure Machine Learning** for custom models requiring full control over training, data, and deployment. Use **Cognitive Services Custom Vision** for quick image classification with minimal ML expertise. For manufacturing defect detection, **Azure ML** is the right choice due to complex requirements.

data.title: Azure ML - Training Script
data.code:
from azure.ai.ml import MLClient
from azure.ai.ml.entities import AmlCompute, Environment

ml_client = MLClient(subscription_id, resource_group, workspace_name)

# Define compute target
compute = AmlCompute(name="gpu-cluster", size="Standard_NC6s_v3", min_instances=0, max_instances=4)

# Submit training job
from azure.ai.ml import command
job = command(
    code="./src",
    command="python train.py --data ${{inputs.data}} --model ${{outputs.model}}",
    inputs=dict(data=dict(type="uri_folder", path="./data")),
    outputs=dict(model=dict(type="uri_folder", path="./outputs")),
    environment="AzureML-sklearn-1.0-ubuntu20.04-py38-cpu:1",
    compute="gpu-cluster",
    display_name="defect-detection-training"
)
ml_client.jobs.create_or_update(job)

data.text: **Azure ML** provides MLOps capabilities, custom environments, distributed training, and deployment options. **Custom Vision** is limited to image classification and doesn't support complex manufacturing workflows.
